Name of Test Case: Submit guest visit RSVP registration form
Action to Take: Fill in name 'Sarah Jenkins', contact 'sarah@example.org', select 'Sunday 9:00 AM', party size 3, and click 'Let us know you’re coming'.
Expected Outcome: Form submits to POST /api/visits, receives visit token, saves token to localStorage, and updates UI to registered state.

Name of Test Case: Validate required fields in visit registration
Action to Take: Leave name and contact fields blank and click 'Let us know you’re coming'.
Expected Outcome: Browser displays HTML5 validation prompt on required name and contact inputs; submission is halted.

Name of Test Case: Select service time from dynamic dropdown
Action to Take: Click service time dropdown and select second gathering 'Sunday 11:00 AM'.
Expected Outcome: Selected service time state updates and is included in the visit payload.

Name of Test Case: Toggle 'I’d like someone to meet me' host checkbox
Action to Take: Uncheck the 'I’d like someone to meet me at the front doors' checkbox.
Expected Outcome: wantsHost state sets to false; submitted visit payload reflects 'wants_host: false'.

Name of Test Case: Click 'I’m on my way' arrival notification button
Action to Take: On the confirmed visit card, click 'I’m on my way' button.
Expected Outcome: Visits API updates status to 'on_the_way'; welcome team queue receives live status update.

Action to Take: On confirmed visit card, click 'I have arrived' button.
Expected Outcome: Visits API updates status to 'arrived'; triggers desktop notification on welcome team workstation.

Name of Test Case: Expand FAQ accordion to read answer
Action to Take: Click on question 'What should I wear?' in the FAQ section.
Expected Outcome: Accordion item expands revealing helpful answer about casual attire.

Action to Take: Click 'Get directions' button next to the church address.
Expected Outcome: Opens Google Maps search query with church street address in new browser tab.

Name of Test Case: Interactive parking spot selection on mobile Safari touchscreens
Action to Take: Tap parking spot on campus SVG map using an iOS Safari mobile browser.
Expected Outcome: Spot highlights and selection binds to form payload.

Name of Test Case: Guest RSVP submission with international phone number format
Action to Take: Enter international format contact number '+44 20 7946 0958' in RSVP contact field.
Expected Outcome: Validates international phone format and registers visit.
